In contrast, blockchain-based payment solutions like NOWPayments offer a secure, fast, and reliable alternative, processing transactions in under 60 seconds with fees under $0.10. But what about the infrastructure required to support these payments? How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, traditional payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal often rely on cumbersome workarounds, such as requiring sellers to use a US bank account or partnering with a third-party payment service provider. These solutions may seem like a viable alternative, but they come with significant drawbacks, including higher fees, slower payment processing, and reduced control over the payment experience. In contrast, blockchain-based payment solutions like NOWPayments are designed from the ground up to support restricted countries, using advanced cryptography and smart contracts to facilitate secure and compliant transactions. Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to digital commerce, ownership, automation, and delivery are critical considerations for Zimbabwean digital sellers. Traditional payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal may offer some level of automation, but they often require sellers to relinquish control over their payment experience, making it difficult to scale and optimize their business. In contrast, blockchain-based payment solutions like NOWPayments offer a high degree of automation, enabling sellers to focus on growth and customer satisfaction. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages and Workers, sellers can create custom delivery experiences, automate their payment processing, and reduce their reliance on third-party services.

For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
